fact.en: A balanced chemical equation has the same number of each type of atom on both sides, because atoms are never lost or created in a reaction.
fact.tl: Ang balanced chemical equation ay may parehong bilang ng bawat uri ng atom sa magkabilang panig, dahil ang mga atom ay hindi nawawala o nalilikha sa isang reaction.
fact.bis: Ang balanced chemical equation adunay parehas nga gidaghanon sa matag klase sa atom sa duha ka kilid, kay ang mga atom dili mawala o mamugna sa usa ka reaction.

cards.illustration: A simple pan balance with shiny spheres representing atoms sitting equally on both pans.

fact.en: Coefficients are the big numbers written before chemical formulas, and they tell you how many whole groups of that substance take part.
fact.tl: Ang coefficients ay ang malalaking numero na isinusulat bago ang chemical formula, at sinasabi nito kung ilang buong grupo ng substance ang kasali.
fact.bis: Ang coefficients mao ang dagkong mga numero nga gisulat sa atubangan sa chemical formula, ug kini nagsulti kung pila ka tibuok grupo sa substance ang miapil.

cards.illustration: A close-up of a chemical equation where a large number 2 is written in front of a molecule made of colored balls.

fact.en:
How do you know if an equation is balanced?

Count the atoms of each element on the reactant side and the product side. If every element has the same count on both sides, the equation is balanced!
fact.tl:
Paano mo malalaman kung balanced ang isang equation?

Bilangin ang mga atom ng bawat element sa reactant side at product side. Kung pareho ang bilang ng bawat element sa magkabilang panig, balanced ang equation!
fact.bis:
Giunsa nimo pagkahibalo kung balanse ang usa ka equation?

Ihap ang mga atom sa matag element sa reactant side ug product side. Kung parehas ang ihap sa matag element sa duha ka kilid, balanse ang equation!

cards.illustration: A child pointing at two sides of a simple equation, counting on their fingers as they compare groups of colored atom balls.

fact.en: In every chemical reaction, atoms are conserved, meaning they just rearrange into new partners instead of being created or destroyed.
fact.tl: Sa bawat chemical reaction, ang mga atom ay conserved, ibig sabihin nag-aayos lang sila ng bagong mga kapareha imbes na malikha o masira.
fact.bis: Sa matag chemical reaction, ang mga atom kay conserved, nagpasabot nga naghan-ay lang sila og bag-ong mga pares imbes nga mamugna o maguba.

cards.illustration: A group of colored balls linked together, then the same balls shown in a different arrangement, with no balls added or removed.

fact.en: When mercury(II) oxide is heated, it decomposes into liquid mercury and oxygen gas, written as 2HgO becomes 2Hg plus O2.
fact.tl: Kapag pinainit ang mercury(II) oxide, ito ay nagde-decompose sa liquid mercury at oxygen gas, na isinusulat bilang 2HgO nagiging 2Hg plus O2.
fact.bis: Kung initon ang mercury(II) oxide, kini ma-decompose ngadto sa liquid mercury ug oxygen gas, nga gisulat isip 2HgO nahimong 2Hg plus O2.

cards.illustration: A test tube with orange powder being heated over a flame, with tiny silver droplets of mercury forming and bubbles of oxygen gas rising.

fact.en:
Why do we write 4Al before aluminum in the equation for aluminum oxide?

Because four aluminum atoms are needed to join with three O2 molecules to make two formula units of aluminum oxide, Al2O3!
fact.tl:
Bakit isinusulat natin ang 4Al bago ang aluminum sa equation para sa aluminum oxide?

Dahil kailangan ng apat na aluminum atom para sumama sa tatlong O2 molecules upang makagawa ng dalawang formula units ng aluminum oxide, Al2O3!
fact.bis:
Ngano gisulat nato ang 4Al sa atubangan sa aluminum sa equation para sa aluminum oxide?

Kay kinahanglan og upat ka aluminum atom aron moapil sa tulo ka O2 molecules para makahimo og duha ka formula units sa aluminum oxide, Al2O3!

cards.illustration: Four silver aluminum balls and three pairs of red oxygen balls coming together to form two clusters, each with two aluminum and three oxygen balls.

fact.en: Liquid carbon disulfide reacts with oxygen gas to produce carbon dioxide gas and sulfur dioxide gas, balanced as CS2 plus 3O2 gives CO2 plus 2SO2.
fact.tl: Ang liquid carbon disulfide ay nagre-react sa oxygen gas upang makagawa ng carbon dioxide gas at sulfur dioxide gas, na bina-balance bilang CS2 plus 3O2 nagbibigay ng CO2 plus 2SO2.
fact.bis: Ang liquid carbon disulfide mo-react sa oxygen gas aron makahimo og carbon dioxide gas ug sulfur dioxide gas, nga gi-balance isip CS2 plus 3O2 naghatag og CO2 plus 2SO2.

cards.illustration: A flask of clear liquid with gas bubbles, and above it two different gas molecules floating away as separate clusters of colored balls.

fact.en:
Why does balancing aluminum with hydrochloric acid need a 2 in front of Al?

Because one aluminum atom makes AlCl3, but hydrogen gas leaves as H2, so two aluminum atoms are needed to pair up the six chlorine atoms and three hydrogen molecules!
fact.tl:
Bakit kailangan ng 2 sa harap ng Al kapag bina-balance ang aluminum at hydrochloric acid?

Dahil ang isang aluminum atom ay gumagawa ng AlCl3, ngunit ang hydrogen gas ay umaalis bilang H2, kaya kailangan ng dalawang aluminum atom para mapares ang anim na chlorine atom at tatlong hydrogen molecules!
fact.bis:
Ngano kinahanglan og 2 sa atubangan sa Al kung i-balance ang aluminum ug hydrochloric acid?

Kay ang usa ka aluminum atom mohimo og AlCl3, apan ang hydrogen gas mogawas isip H2, busa kinahanglan og duha ka aluminum atom aron mapares ang unom ka chlorine atom ug tulo ka hydrogen molecules!

cards.illustration: A beaker with gray aluminum metal pieces fizzing, while bubbles of hydrogen gas rise and a white aluminum chloride solid forms at the bottom.
